notesMarkdown:
# Lock Desk

Keep the Flippa thread for anything official. This page is extra help for the transfer.

## What you already have
- A finished UK Amazon Associates review and comparison magazine, not a mockup
- The web domain **lockdesk.co.uk** (Flippa sites always include a domain)
- Hosting on Vercel
- Source on GitHub if you want the repo (https://github.com/aipagesnow/amazon1)
- The product slice in `data/products.json` (ASINs and facts only)

You do **not** receive Mothership, the seller's central catalogue.

## Amazon Associates
Outbound buttons say **See on Amazon**. After you have the Vercel project, set this environment variable to your own UK Associates tag (usually ending in `-21`):

```
AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG
```

Without it, links will not credit you. We do not transfer an Amazon Associates account. You apply for amazon.co.uk Associates yourself.

`.env.example` in the repo shows the shape only (`your-tag-21`). Never commit a real tag.

## What we need from you
1. The registrar account that should receive **lockdesk.co.uk** (often GoDaddy)
2. The email for Vercel
3. A GitHub username if you want the repository

Use the form on this page. After you send it, we do the moving.

## If you get stuck
Use the chat. Extra help (Grok) can join, find a YouTube video, and mark the bits to look at. We transfer Vercel and push the domain — you accept those emails. After you send the form, this page shows how-tos for your setup (GoDaddy is simplest; another registrar is fine). GitHub only appears if you asked for the repo.
